title: crafting recipe Elytra
description: Survival‑friendly datapack: Elytra can be crafted with Blaze Powder, ,Dried Ghast,Fireworks, and Netherite Upgrade.
body:
Elytra Crafting Datapack introduces a symbolic and balanced late-game recipe for Elytra wings, allowing players to craft this legendary item through a ritual of rare ingredients.
✨ Recipe Components
• 🔥 Blaze Powder ×2 — flame of propulsion
• 😈 Dried Ghast ×2— essence of sorrow
• 🎆 Firework Rockets ×2 — spark of flight
• 🛡️ Netherite Upgrade ×1 — symbol of mastery
🛠️ Features
• Shaped crafting recipe with symmetrical layout
• Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.8
• No external dependencies
• Ideal for survival worlds, RPG servers, and museum-style progression
⚖️ Balance & Philosophy
• Requires rare and meaningful ingredients
• Preserves the prestige of Elytra while making it accessible through effort
• Fireworks reinforce the link between wings and flight mechanics
• Perfect for worlds without End access or custom progression paths
